name: Open-Domain Dialogue LLM Benchmark
description: A benchmark/evaluation suite for assessing large language models on open-domain dialogue quality, covering evaluation scenarios and metrics for conversational responses.
evaluation_method: human_eval (mean ratings / pairwise preference) and automatic metrics (BERTScore, BLEU/ROUGE, USR)
reputation: Recent benchmark from the NLP4ConvAI workshop with growing interest among conversational-AI researchers but not yet a universal standard.
notes: High risk of data contamination for models trained on web/dialogue corpora; automatic metrics correlate poorly with human judgments; human evaluation is costly and can be inconsistent across annotators; multi-turn context makes reliable automatic scoring difficult.
